newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic, NYNEX deal may see delays - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic, NYNEX deal may see delays - WSJ.

text.p: Bell Atlantic and NYNEX could face more delays in closing their proposed merger and some company officials say the U.S. Justice Department might try to impose tough conditions, the Wall Street Journal said on Wednesday.
The two companies would meet Wednesday with senior officials of the Justice Department's antitrust division, the paper said in its electronic edition.
Some company officials believe the Justice Department might try to put stringent conditions or perhaps oppose the deal, the paper said.

"We're a little concerned," the Journal quoted one executive as saying. The executive thought there was a five percent chance the government would try to challenge the $23 billion deal, the paper said.
The U.S. telecommunications companies agreed to merge in April last year.
